title: Strict representatives of a derived commutative square
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a derived category. For a commutative square with horizontal arrows f:X to Y and f':X' to Y' and vertical arrows a:X to X', b:Y to Y', there exist four cochain complexes K,L,K',L', arrows g,g',s,r with g r = s g', and isomorphisms from their images under Q to X,Y,X',Y', identifying each of the four localized arrows with the corresponding given arrow.

proof.text: Choose a complex for Y'. Repeatedly use DerivedCategory.right_fac to lift b, f', a, f, with a common source for the two outgoing arrows. Use MorphismProperty.map_eq_iff_precomp on Qh to refine this source until the composites agree in the homotopy category. Quotient fullness and homotopyOfEq give chain maps and a homotopy H of their composites. The roof factorizations give the four derived map identities.

Replace L by L direct-sum Cone(id K), g by (g,inr), and r by (r,z), where mappingCone.desc applied to H.symm gives z with inr z = s g' - g r. The square is strictly commutative. The identity cone is contractible, so the projection onto L is invertible under Q and Q(z)=0. Use this projection to transport the comparison for Y and check all four map identities.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_commutative_square_lift
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    {X Y X' Y' : DerivedCategory C}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (a : X ⟶ X') (b : Y ⟶ Y')
    (h : f ≫ b = a ≫ f') :
    ∃ (K L K' L' : CochainComplex C ℤ)
      (g : K ⟶ L) (g' : K' ⟶ L') (s : K ⟶ K') (t : L ⟶ L')
      (_hc : g ≫ t = s ≫ g')
      (eX : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ X) (eY : DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ Y)
      (eX' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K' ≅ X') (eY' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj L' ≅ Y'),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map g ≫ eY.hom = eX.hom ≫ f ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map g' ≫ eY'.hom = eX'.hom ≫ f' ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map s ≫ eX'.hom = eX.hom ≫ a ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map t ≫ eY'.hom = eY.hom ≫ b
